remarks: Stunning, grandly-scaled & remarkably-built stone & shingle classic located in THE quintessential, Compo Beach neighborhood (quieter & NOT in the flood plain) w/expansive, private, level property, embraced by stone walls & scenic entertaining opportunities 2nd to none. Just a short walk to celebrated Westport beaches, Longshore Club, Saugatuck Center & Metro Nth Station footpath, in coveted AA zone, across from Aspetuck Land Trust wooded scenery. Thoughtfully-designed, impeccable 10,000+ SF on 3 levels + enormous walkup attic for expansion potential. Fabulous wide plank oak floors thru-out, stone detail, & many recent upgrades/improvements, incl gorgeous newly-resurfacd, heated pool/spa. Capacious interiors w/great flow, stately rooms & high-qual finishes, including: lux LR, library & banquet-sized formal DR w/extensive butlers pantry; spacious gourmet, prof-equip "front-to-back" country kitchen w/lg bkfst area & walk-in pantry; massive sunroom addt'n adjoining veranda & overlooking lush surroundings. Grand primary suite above has spacious sep sitting w/fpl, tray ceil, spa bth & 3 w-i closets, built-ins & coffee bar; 5 other fam BRs, incl enormous sep bonus suite; massive walkout lower entertaining level, equip w/bar, guest bth + poten. 7th BR. Covered front & rear porches, cabana, expansive bluestone patios in pool area, separate gourmet cooking area, Oversized garage/utility spaces & systems complete this inviting picture. Note: Owners have used bonus suite/6th BR as office
